project_type: FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy ORM and synchronous simulation engine
verification_instructions: Run pytest with -v flag to execute all tests in backend/tests/. Tests use in-memory SQLite and auto-reset orchestrator via conftest.py fixtures.
environment_constraints: DATABASE_URL set to sqlite:///:memory: in conftest.py for tests. Orchestrator is a global singleton that must be reset between tests. WebSocket broadcasting uses asyncio.Queue list in orchestrator.active_subscribers.
contribution_requirements: All new endpoints must be added to routers with proper Pydantic schemas. Database operations use SessionLocal context manager. Orchestrator owns authoritative simulation state; DB is persistence layer only.
key_patterns: Routers import orchestrator singleton and read orchestrator.latest_telemetry for live state. DB models in backend/models/db_models.py, Pydantic schemas in backend/models/schemas.py. Tests use client fixture from conftest.py with TestClient(app). Asset status mapping: Solar uses fault_reduction_pct for Online/Degraded/Faulted, Battery uses is_tripped for Connected/Faulted, Grid uses is_connected and is_faulted for Connected/Faulted status.
directory_structure: backend/ contains routers/ (API endpoints), simulation/ (orchestrator + domain models), models/ (schemas.py Pydantic, db_models.py SQLAlchemy), tests/ (pytest suite with conftest.py). No services/ directory exists yet.
